name: 6th
source:
After falling asleep, Francis mysteriously finds himself in what feels like his old home.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210917122054/https://beamingghost.itch.io/6th[/url]]
translation:
法蘭西斯入睡後，不知怎地來到一處讓他想起舊家的地方。
